out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. A can of energy drink was on one of the food storage shelves in the kitchen prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. Employees can have drinks in the kitchen, however they must be served in a covered cup with a straw. The manager removed the drink during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. The inside of the ice machine was visibly soiled and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Clean the inside of the ice machine soon as possible before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Vinegar was stored with bleach under the food prep sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Vinegar is considered food and should not be stored on the floor and also should not be stored with toxic chemicals, such as bleach. All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC moved the vinegar to an appropriate location during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed several personal care items, such as Band-Aids, peroxide, and others stored with and over food or food equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. Store personal care items in an area separate from food and food equipment and to prevent contamination. The PIC move the personal care items during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observe, vacuum packaged (salmon) fish being thawed improperly at room temperature. The vacuum packaging was still intact.
violations.corrective_action: Whenever thawing vacuum packed fish the packages must be cut open to prevent the growth of anaerobic bacteria. The PIC cut the packages open during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw frozen chicken was being thawed in properly at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Discontinue thawing foods at room temperature. Instead follow one of the recommendations above. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed several foods, including a case of bottled water, raw chicken and others stored on the floor in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Store all food at least 6 inches out the floor. Correct as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. One of the cooks was not wearing a hair or straight while preparing foods.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. The cook put on a hair restrained during the inspection. ELEPHANT JUMPS (Inspection Date: 04/30/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Store, wet, wiping cloths in a sanitizer solution between uses. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: utensils were not being stored properly in foods. They were being stored with the handles in the foods. Keep the handles out of the food, prevent contamination of the food. Also observed in use utensils being stored in 73°F standing water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Keep utensil handles out of food to prevent contamination of food. Don’t store utensils and standing water unless the water is 135°F or above. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed the ambient temperature of two door upright freezer in the kitchen was 27°F.
violations.corrective_action: Monitor the foods in the freezer to ensure they are kept frozen. The ambient temperature of a freezer should be closer to 0°F. Repair or replace the freezer as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: Water for cleaning the woks is being provided with a non-food grade hose and a non-food grade hose end sprayer, neither of which are approved for this use. The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. Garden hoses and sprayers are not approved for use in a commercial kitchen. The PIC indicated they intend to install a properly plumbed and drained wok station(s). Until then, discontinue using the non-food grade hose and non-food grade hose and sprayer, or replace them with food grade equipment. Food grade hoses and sprayers can be purchased at your local home improvement store or online. Correct within three days.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: The hose being used to provide water at the wok station is installed on a hose bib spigot and without a an approved vacuum breaker which is designed to prevent backflow and protect the waterlines.
violations.corrective_action: Install a vacuum breaker within the next three days. Hose bib vacuum breakers can be purchased at your local home improvement store or online.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: Observed improper disposal of sewage: waste water from cleaning the woks was being drained from the woks by a water pump connected to a green garden hose, and the garden hose drained into the floor drain about 20 feet away. This is not an approved method.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC indicated that they intend to install a new wok station(s) with proper plumbing and drainage integrated in it. Install the new wok station as soon as possible. The drains for the wok station must go through a grease trap to protect the waste lines from grease building-up. Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. There is a unused blender stored on the shelf in the kitchen, which the manager stated they will not use.
violations.corrective_action: Remove the unused blender and any other unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. Correct as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: There were several burnt out lightbulbs in the ceiling light fixtures. These fixtures are four bulb fixtures, but in most cases, only two bulbs were working.
violations.corrective_action: Replace the non-working or broke out lightbulbs as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months. All four bulbs in all fixtures should be working.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observe grease on the wall and main gas line pipe in front of it located under next to the hood.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the excess grease from the wall and the gas line as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.
